description: Payhere is a Stripe-backed payment links platform. This plugin reads the account user, company and 30-day stats, lists customers, payments, plans and subscriptions, reads a customer with their payment history, issues full or partial refunds, and receives HMAC-verified payment and subscription webhooks.

api.description: Read the company of the authenticated user

fields.type: { id: number, name?: string | null, legal_name?: string | null, slug?: string | null, country_code?: string | null, currency?: string | null, stripe_connected?: boolean | null, gocardless_connected?: boolean | null }
fields.description: The Payhere company of the authenticated user

api.description: Read the payment stats of the last 30 days with comparisons

fields.description: Currency the stats are reported in
Payment volume of the last 30 days
Payment volume of the 30-60 days before, for comparison
New subscribers of the last 30 days
New subscribers of the 30-60 days before, for comparison

api.description: Read one customer with their subscriptions and payment history

fields.type: { id: number, name?: string | null, email?: string | null, created_at?: string | null, updated_at?: string | null, subscriptions?: {}[] | null, payments?: {}[] | null }
